label: Heart rate

howTo.step: Count beats for 60 seconds or use a heart-rate sensor.

why: Heart rate is used by the demo to track cardiovascular changes.

warn: Repeat the measurement and review the trend.
crit: Repeat the measurement and seek professional medical assessment.

label: Blood pressure

howTo.step: Use a suitable blood pressure cuff.

why: Blood pressure readings are used by the demo to track cardiovascular changes.

crit: Repeat the measurement and seek professional medical assessment.

label: Body temperature

howTo.step: Measure temperature using a suitable thermometer.
Record the value and measurement time.

why: Temperature is used by the demo to track changes over time.

warn: Repeat the measurement and review other symptoms.
crit: Repeat the measurement and seek professional medical assessment.

label: Blood oxygen saturation

howTo.step: Place the pulse oximeter correctly on a finger.

why: Oxygen saturation is used by the demo to track respiratory status.

warn: Repeat the measurement and check the sensor placement.
crit: Repeat the measurement and seek urgent professional medical assessment.

label: Blood glucose

howTo.step: Record the result and whether it was taken before or after a meal.

why: Glucose is used by the demo to track metabolic changes.

warn: Repeat the measurement and review the context of the reading.
crit: Repeat the measurement and seek professional medical assessment.

label: Sleep duration

howTo.step: Record the number of hours slept during the previous sleep period.

why: Sleep duration is used by the demo to track rest and recovery.

warn: Review your sleep schedule and allow time for rest.
crit: Review your rest schedule and consider discussing persistent sleep problems with a professional.

label: Mood

howTo.step: Rate your current mood from 1 to 5.

why: Mood is used by the demo to track self-reported wellbeing.

warn: Consider taking a break and talking with a crewmate.
crit: Consider seeking support from a qualified professional.
